segments.name: Manufacturing and Engineering
segments.description: Designs, engineers and assembles microwave amplifiers, subsystems and passive components to customer specifications for satellite, defense, space and telecom customers.
segments.evidence: AmpliTech, Inc. designs, engineers and assembles micro-wave component-based amplifiers that meet individual customer specifications.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Distributes integrated circuit packages and lids used for semiconductor device assembly, prototyping, testing and production to customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The manufacturing and engineering segment assembles microwave components, and the distribution segment is a global distributor of integrated circuits packages and lids.

revenueModel.text: Aerospace, government, defense, satellite and telecom customers buy amplifiers, subsystems and components, plus engineering services billed per project or time and materials.
revenueModel.evidence: We also offer non-recurring engineering services on a project-by-project basis, for a predetermined fixed contractual amount, or on a time plus material basis.
